title: Course programs and bounded AI/science foundations
summary: Apply explicit audience, prerequisites, outcomes, workload and next steps across the catalogue; add five substantial AI/science labs and preserve existing lessons.

changes.detail: Bounded introductory AI evaluation, evidence-based LLM applications, scripted agent execution and science investigations, each with actual exercises, rubrics and capstones.
All existing courses receive explicit program briefs. React preparation now precedes the Next.js guide. Workshop language is explicitly declared; original lessons remain available.
Structural inventory identifies short exposition and missing assessments as manual-review prompts, not automatic quality scores.
